files.html:
0.1.6 Change Log

Added

  • Added full dialogue text pagination, including configurable previous/next controls that preserve typing-reveal behavior and saved GUI layout values.
  • Added searchable Item ID selection to the NPC Shop Editor and searchable Item, CustomNPCs faction, advancement, and FTB Quest ID pickers to the shared Condition Editor.
  • Added an optional public FTB Quests compatibility service and picker for quest/task discovery, state checks, and verified completion without making FTB Quests a hard dependency.
  • Added public item-picker and render-neutral item-catalog APIs, allowing addons to reuse DRM's localized item registry search without importing internal screens.
  • Added searchable Remnant Message and policy JSON selectors, plus per-marker scale, billboard, and item-transform settings with server-side validation and persistence.
  • Added validated #RRGGBB input and color-code copy/paste controls to the Dialogue Editor's text-style tools.

Changed

  • Changed the shared Condition Editor to use compact key/value fields and support drag-and-drop condition reordering with auto-scroll and an insertion guide.
  • Changed long dialogue choices to fit their configured viewport while preserving scrolling for genuinely overflowing choice lists.
  • Changed built-in editor names and the NPC Apply interface to use localization keys; all 11 bundled locales now share the same key set.
  • Changed NPC Apply text layout to use font-width clipping and pixel-aligned scaling for sharper text at fractional GUI scales.
  • Changed the Remnant Message Setter item to use its dedicated model texture instead of the vanilla stick texture.
  • Changed automatic currency conversion and death-loss handling to notify the affected player in chat.

Fixed

  • Fixed wallet and bank balances not being copied to the replacement player after respawn.
  • Fixed ordinary currency pickup processing sweeping unrelated currency stacks already present in the player's inventory.
  • Fixed HUD Maker recursively requesting a valid empty currency catalog until a StackOverflowError occurred.
  • Fixed Remnant condition and action edits mutating detached JSON arrays, causing successful-looking changes to be lost when saved.
  • Fixed Dialogue Editor Save followed by Close showing a false unsaved-change warning while the matching save acknowledgement was pending.
  • Fixed long translated dialogue choice labels moving whole buttons instead of remaining inside stable configured rows.
